explanatory_strength.rationale: Owner-earnings story is straightforward: subscription software converting to $9.85B free cash flow with light maintenance capex ($179M), 96% subscription revenue mix, and large buybacks ($11.28B). Franchise quality is high; the open question is whether reinvestment into Firefly/AI preserves owner cash growth or only defends share.

evidence_sufficiency.rationale: FY2025 FCF, shares, RPO, cash, debt, and SBC are filing-reconciled with decision-grade proofs. Quality of earnings is strong on cash conversion, but segment FCF is allocated by revenue weight, management_facts is empty, and incremental AI spend (~$850M reserved in proofs) lacks a verified attach-rate bridge.

downside_control.rationale: Balance sheet can fund the franchise through a de-rating: $5.4B cash versus ~$6.2B long-term debt after the 2025 note issuance. votes.specialist_findings: Within the Munger power zone for moat and inversion review. Competitive advantage looks stable: workflow switching costs, 95% Digital Media gross margin, and enterprise Experience contracts. Invert the lollapalooza: generative-AI lowers creative-tool barriers while Lawrence synthesis at 32% leans on 9% growth and a 25× exit, so a great business can still be a wrong-price bet if seat momentum stalls. pre_mortem.failure_story: We treated Adobe as a subscription compounder on FY2025 owner cash of $23.07 per share, with contract base value $656 per share versus about $235 spot and Lawrence synthesis near 32% per year. The failure path was competitive, not solvency: generative-AI alternatives eroded Creative Cloud net seat additions faster than Firefly monetization offset, RPO growth lagged revenue for two consecutive quarters, and Digital Media ARPU stalled as individual-tier pricing capped while Experience Cloud deals slowed with marketing-budget cuts. Trailing free cash flow per share drifted toward the contract falsifier below $18, buybacks slowed as debt stayed elevated after the 2025 note offering, and the market re-rated Adobe from pricing-power compounder to AI-disrupted legacy software. Selling multiples compressed from the 25× Lawrence exit assumption toward the high teens; hold-period return landed near the bear Lawrence envelope and far below the synthesis base case. Equity de-rating on a partial-dhando name, not distress, was the primary capital-loss path.
